name: singlet_ingest_quant_barcode_whitelist_correction
title: Cell barcode correction (whitelist or inferred set)
description: Corrects observed cell barcodes against a whitelist or a barcode set inferred from counts, and writes a decision per distinct barcode, a corrected barcode per read and a corrected cell-barcode count table. The default method unique corrects only barcodes with exactly one one-substitution candidate; frequency accepts a count-share leader; exact disables correction. Requires the parse stream from barcode extraction. Do not use to call cells or to correct UMIs.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle.

parse_stream.description: Parse stream from barcode extraction; null uses the stream recorded for this dataset.

whitelist.description: Whitelist path or catalogue name, or 'inferred' to derive the set from observed counts.

method.description: unique is the default and corrects only unambiguous one-substitution barcodes; exact disables correction.

neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood for non-exact barcodes; shift-aware neighbourhoods are abundance heuristics, not indel models.

frequency.description: Options for method frequency: share threshold, pseudocount and optional Phred weighting.

confidence.description: Share the leader must reach; 0.975 matches STARsolo cbMinP and alevin-fry RNA.

pseudocount.description: Added to each candidate's exact count before the share is computed.

use_quality.description: Weight candidates by the Phred error at the mismatched base; requires base qualities.

inferred.description: Options when whitelist is inferred: knee rule, expected-cell bound and above-knee handling.

knee_method.description: Knee rule applied to ranked barcode counts.

expect_cells.description: Expected cell number bounding the inferred set; null applies the knee alone.

above_knee.description: Handling of above-knee barcodes with a higher-count near miss; none disables it.

correction_out.description: Path of the per-read correction sidecar; null writes a file beside the dataset.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without reading the stream.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members and the sidecar instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: finished inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, neighbourhood, whitelist_size, n_distinct_observed, n_exact, n_corrected, n_ambiguous, n_no_candidate, n_below_threshold, corrected_read_fraction, n_above_knee_changed. Never per-read records.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
